# Devplane

> Devplane puts in front of you, in minutes, the evidence for deciding whether an agent's change is safe to merge — evidence your own project produces — and keeps the record of how you know. One local binary: no account, no cloud relay, loopback only.

- **Change**: a branch, its own git worktree, an agent (any ACP agent) running in it, gate reports, decisions and a done certificate. May name a spec folder (Spec Kit, OpenSpec, Kiro, or `[spec] plans`) and task lines. States: drafted, isolated, in flight, verified, offered, archived.
- **Verified**: the latest `[gates] check` exited zero against a digest of the working tree that equals the tree now (uncommitted and untracked non-ignored files included). Named gates never verify. Touching any file makes it stale.
- **Weakened checks**: skipped or loosened checks, deleted tests, edited gates or CI, agent controls, ownership, supply-chain files, and base tests that fail on the change. Shown first; `offer` is refused while one is unseen.
- **Permissions**: Devplane approves nothing on its own. It refuses (`deny`) or asks a person (`ask`), in Claude Code's rule syntax, and allows only by a grant the person wrote in `~/.devplane/policy.toml` (never in a repository). Unloadable rules make every gated call ask. Authorities on the record: `person`, `rule`, `timer`, `nobody`, `devplane`.
- **Nothing auto-starts.** Hooks decide in their own process and write to `~/.devplane/devplane.db`. The host (`devplane up`) is the one long-lived process. Read commands work with no host.

## Docs

- [Install](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/install/): installer, npm, cargo, the desktop app; upgrade and uninstall.
- [Quickstart](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/quickstart/): a practice repository to a verified change.
- [Troubleshooting](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/troubleshooting/): a symptom and the command that fixes it.
- [The workbench](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/workbench/): regions, a change's six views, the review, keys.
- [Verified done](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/verified-done/): gate, tree digest, states, review, offer, base checks, certificate.
- [Working to a specification](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/specs/): `--spec`, `--task`, ticked vs verified, drift, drafting, the Spec Kit hook.
- [CI verify](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/ci/): the workflow step, exit codes, the summary.
- [Watching sessions](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/observe/): roster, hooks, OpenTelemetry, status line.
- [Driving agents](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/agents/): built-in ACP agents, `agents.toml`.
- [The decision log](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/decisions/): authorities and what is recorded.
- [CLI reference](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/cli/): every command and flag.
- [Configuration](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/configuration/): every `devplane.toml` key; `policy.toml`, `app.toml`, environment. Unknown keys are errors.
- [Permissions](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/permissions/): rule syntax and reach, grants, fail-closed loading.
- [Architecture](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/architecture/): hook writes, host folds, API routes.
- [Security](https://hupe1980.github.io/devplane/docs/security/): trust, loopback and tokens, fail-closed paths, limits.

## Commands

Plain `devplane` is `devplane status`. `--json` is global; errors are `{"error": "..."}` on stdout with a non-zero exit. Ids accept a unique prefix. Starting, steering or stopping an agent needs the host.

- `devplane status [--all] [--project] [--needs-you] [--modes]`: sessions and what asks for a person.
- `devplane run list|show|watch|attach`: sessions; one run; follow events or a driven agent's conversation (`--thinking`, `--history <n>`); resume a session in this terminal.
- `devplane search <query>`: tool calls, questions and errors across sessions.
- `devplane inbox [--project] [--needs-you] [--all]`; `inbox answer <ask>` with `--allow`/`--deny` or `--option`/`--custom`/`--field` (`--allow` refused inside an agent session); `inbox snooze <id> [--minutes] [--until-activity]` (`0` un-snoozes; at most 30 days).
- `devplane audit [id] [--without-me] [--limit] [--otel]`: decisions and their authority.
- `devplane pr list`, `devplane issue list [--ready] [--cwd] [--label]`: open GitHub pull requests and issues across projects.
- `devplane change start "<title>" [--project]... [--agent] [--spec] [--task]... [--issue] [--no-worktree]`.
- `devplane change list|show|review|verify|retry|resume|login|prompt|stop|drift|draft|draft-accept|draft-reject|clarify|adopt|offer|finish|archive|claim-read|export`. `verify [--base-checks]`; `review [--by risk|intent] [--seen <path>]`; `offer` commits exactly the verified tree and opens a draft PR only with `[github] pull_request = true`, else prints the commands, and exits 3 while a weakened row is unseen; `export [--json]` prints the certificate (in-toto statement with `--json`).
- `devplane gate [--cwd] [--name]`: run `check` or a named gate; `passed` exits 0; `failed`, `no_gates`, `config_unreadable`, `unknown_gate` exit 1. Records nothing.
- `devplane gate install --speckit|--skill`: the Spec Kit extension (an `after_implement` hook), or the Claude Code skill `verify`; shown before it is written.
- `devplane verify [--base <ref>] [--summary] [--statement] [--no-base-checks] [--sarif] [--approvals]`: the merge base's `check` on this checkout, then base checks, weakened checks first. Exit 0 verified, 1 failed, 2 could not run. No host; no network unless `--approvals`. `action.yml` runs it in GitHub Actions.
- `devplane project trust [path] [--dry-run] [--yes]`: allow agents after listing hooks and MCP servers.
- `devplane config check|explain|grants|revoke`: validate offline; what the rules decide and why; list or remove your grants.
- `devplane agent list`; `devplane agent connect|disconnect claude|codex|copilot`: hooks into the vendor's settings, diff first.
- `devplane auth login [--host] [--with-token]`, `devplane auth logout`: GitHub; the token lives only in the OS credential store.
- `devplane doctor`: host, gate probe, channels, GitHub sign-ins.
- `devplane completions <shell>`.
- `devplane up [--port] [--no-browser] [--window]`: the host and the workbench; port 47831; a taken port is refused. `devplane down`: stop it, saying first what ends.
- Hidden, for machines: `devplane mcp` (MCP on stdio: `inbox`, `change`, `explain`, `audit`, and `spec_and_tests_conflict` for an agent Devplane started), `devplane hook`, `devplane statusline`.

Claude Code plugin (the MCP server and the `devplane-gate` skill): `claude plugin marketplace add hupe1980/devplane`, then `claude plugin install devplane@devplane`.
